dct_title_s: Land Surface Temperature (L3, Monthly, Night), NOAA-20 / VIIRS
dct_description_sm: The Land Surface Temperature (L3, Monthly, Night) layer shows the temperature of the land surface in Kelvin (K), from the Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) aboard the joint NASA/NOAA NOAA-20 satellite.

The NOAA-20 Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity (LST&E) monthly Climate Modeling Grid Version 2 product (VJ121C3) provides LST&E by a process of selecting the best available pixel over a monthly acquisition period at 0.05 degree (~5,600 meter) resolution. The VJ121C3 dataset is a monthly composite LST&E product that uses an algorithm based on a simple averaging method and is formatted as a CMG for use in climate simulation models. The algorithm calculates the average from all the cloud free VJ121A1D and VJ121A1N daily acquisitions from the monthly period.
The imagery resolution is 1 km, and the temporal resolution is monthly.

A monthly visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2018-01-01 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/JPSS1 Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V002 (VJ121C3, version 002, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/VJ121C3.002).
